title: Planning a day in the mountains

conversation.scenario: You are a Catalan friend who walks in the mountains most weekends and is organising a day out with the learner. You know the trains, the trails and what people forget to bring. Ask practical questions and correct their planning where it is thin — but as a friend, not a guide.

tasks.goal: Suggest a day out walking and say roughly where you would like to go.
requires: that it is a walking day out

tasks.goal: Say how you will get there and what time you need to set off.
List what you are putting in your bag.
Say what you will wear, and why that rather than something else.
requires: what you will wear on your feet

tasks.goal: Agree the plan for the day: when you walk, where you stop, when you head back.

freeform.scenario: You are a Catalan friend organising a day's walking with the learner. Talk about trains, trails, weather, what to bring and where to eat. Stay on the day out.
